name: session-panel
description: A side panel per session: the links the replies carried, grouped under their task, and one line per delivered result; the owner ticks, edits, deletes and adds lines in place

cardsDir.title: Task cards folder
cardsDir.description: Absolute path of the folder with task cards named <TASK-ID>.md; a card whose frontmatter status is a done status folds its task's other links away.

doneStatuses.title: Done statuses
doneStatuses.description: Card frontmatter statuses that count as done.

taskPattern.title: Task id pattern
taskPattern.description: Regular expression a task id matches, searched in a link's address and label.

linkRoots.title: Link roots
linkRoots.description: Absolute (or ~/) folders, besides the session's folder, its repository and the cards folder, whose files a panel line may link to; a path outside every root stays plain text.
